message.content:
Dried lemons fall under heading 0814 or 0813. Heading 0813 covers fruit dried other than that of headings 0801 to 0806, and lemons are in 0805, so dried lemons would go in 0813. Heading 0814 covers peel of citrus fruit or melons, including fresh, frozen, dried or provisionally preserved, which doesn't fit whole lemons.

Within 0813, subheading 0813.40 covers "other fruit," and 0813.40.10 covers longans, lychees, etc. Whole dried lemons would go in 0813.40.90 or a similar line. I recall CBP ruling N-series on dried lemons classifying them in 0813.40.8070? I'm not sure. The HTS 0813.40 lines are: 0813.40.10 Longans, lychees; 0813.40.20 Tamarinds; 0813.40.30 Pears/…; 0813.40.40 ...; 0813.40.50 "Other: Tamarind"? I think the structure is: 0813.40.10 (Longans, fresh or dried), 0813.40.20 (Tamarinds), 0813.40.30 (Other: Dried: Cranberries?), 0813.40.40 (Other), 0813.40.60, 0813.40.70 (Other: Other), 0813.40.80, 0813.40.90... I recall 0813.40.1000 as longans, 0813.40.2000 as tamarind, 0813.40.3000 as longans? I can't verify any of these lines, so I'm settling on 0813.40.8000 as my best guess for other dried fruit, with a statistical suffix of 0813.40.8000.
